name: Mementos
description: Mementos is a benchmark designed to assess multimodal large language models' reasoning abilities over sequences of images, focusing on dynamic and sequential visual information rather than static single images.
reputation: A relatively new but well-cited benchmark in multimodal reasoning, mainly used in recent MLLM evaluation papers rather than as a long-established community standard.
notes: Focuses on sequential image reasoning and identifies hallucination issues in MLLMs; uses GPT-4 assisted evaluation.
